q.line: I looked over it and I ached
stanza: I love everybody because I love you
When you stood up, walked away barefoot
And the grass where you lay left a bed in your shape
I looked over it and I ached

partner.line: And the grass where you lay left a bed in your shape

q.line: And she stood there ashamed of the way her heart ached
stanza: But the crown, it had fallen, and she thought she would break
And she stood there ashamed of the way her heart ached
And she took him to the doorstep and she asked him to wait
She would only be a moment inside

partner.line: But the crown, it had fallen, and she thought she would break

stanza: Last night, again, you were in my dreams
Several expendable limbs were at stake
You were a prince, spinning rims

partner.line: Several expendable limbs were at stake
